# Synthetic Media Fixture

Run `make fixture` from the repository root to create
`tests/fixtures/synthetic/hard_cut_20s.mp4`.

The generated file is about 20 seconds, 1920x1080, has one hard cut at 10
seconds, and includes a sine-wave audio track. It exists only to exercise the
test harness until C1/C2 add real Riksdagen fixtures.
